_comment: Every source, and what a healthy run of it looks like.
THE GUARDRAILS ARE MEASURED, NOT GUESSED. Each number below is what the
source actually returned on the run that produced the committed data. They
are the tripwire for the failure this whole pipeline is built around: a
parser that silently starts returning nothing, or a source that quietly
stops publishing the one field the feature depends on.
min_ratio is applied to the PREVIOUS GOOD RUN as well as to min_records, so
the floor rises as an airport grows and a sudden shrink is always refused.
security_basis pins what a source is allowed to claim. HKG publishes a
per-outlet boolean, so 'explicit' is required: if they ever stop, the run
is refused rather than silently degrading to guesswork.

airports.notes: The dining page is a JS shell. This static JSON is what it loads; found via shopping_categories.js -> hkia.js config.
